title: Better and Cheaper Than IPTV
summary: Castor is an open-source streaming platform that provides a cheaper and more flexible alternative to traditional IPTV services, allowing users to stream live TV, movies, and other content through a self-hosted or lightweight solution.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, open-source alternative to expensive commercial IPTV subscriptions for streaming television content.
why_valuable: It offers significant cost savings while giving users full control over their streaming infrastructure without relying on costly third-party IPTV providers.
